faqs.a:
(a)
The adoption of this article shall not be construed to repeal or in any way to affect
               or to modify:
(1)
Any substantive or vested right;
(2)
Any law authorizing the issuance of any outstanding special assessment local improvement
               bonds of the city;
(3)
Any law pursuant to which special assessments levied by the city have not been paid
               in full, including principal, interest and any penalties; and
(4)
The running of any statute of limitation in force at the time this article becomes
               effective.
(b)
All incomplete proceedings had and taken under any ordinance hereby repealed, preliminary
               to and in the acquisition or improvement, or acquisition and improvement, of any project,
               the creation of any district, the levy and collection of any assessment or the issuance
               of any interim warrant, any bond, any temporary bond, any refunding bond, or any other
               security appertaining to such project, which proceedings are in substantial compliance
               herewith, may, at the option of the council, be completed hereunder the same as if
               such incomplete proceedings had been had and taken pursuant to the provisions hereof.
(Code 1981, § 27-154; Ord. No. 551, § 96, 5-14-1964)
